rows.question: Hi! I have never been here before. What is DeskAtlas and how does it work?
rows.summary:
With DeskAtlas, you can book a workspace online or walk in.

To start, visit the customer website to select a physical desk or room, choose your date and time, and enter your guest contact details.

After submitting your request, you will receive official payment instructions. You must pay and upload proof of payment within 60 minutes. A pending status or queue number does not hold inventory; your booking is only confirmed after an administrator reviews your payment proof and allocates a specific unit.

Alternatively, you can use the on-site shared kiosk as a walk-in option. Staff will verify your request and assignment. Note that browsing or queue assignment at the kiosk does not hold the space.

rows.question: What if my plans change or I arrive late? Can I cancel, move the booking, or get a refund?
rows.summary:
To cancel or reschedule, you must request at least 24 hours before your start time; same-day changes are not accepted under the standard rule. If eligible, cancellations qualify for a 50% refund of the verified payment base, subject to authorized approval.

For late arrivals, the booking end time does not shift automatically. If you need to move a confirmed booking, contact the front desk or official SKYDY Messenger with your reference and reason; do not occupy a new space until a revised confirmation is issued.

Retain your booking reference and original payment receipt. Share these through verified private channels only, as chat requests do not automatically cancel bookings or process refunds.

rows.question: Okay, what happens after that?
rows.summary:
No, advance booking is not required for a first-time walk-in. The on-site kiosk is the designated account-free channel for visitors physically present at SKYDY. You may select a specific physical desk or room, review the current quote, and provide your guest details directly at the kiosk. This process does not require a personal account, a Unique Customer ID, or prior reservation.

After selecting your workspace and schedule, you will choose a payment route, such as Cash at the Front Desk or a static QR Payment.

You must retain your kiosk queue number and any transfer receipt.

Staff will then verify your request, payment, and eligibility.

You may only check in after the eligible assignment and attendance process is fully confirmed by staff.

rows.question: What should I do if the internet stops working or another guest is being noisy while I am working?
rows.summary: Report the Wi-Fi outage or noisy guest to on-site staff immediately. Temporary loss of internet or noise issues do not automatically grant extra session time, change your booking status, or waive payment. Follow any posted safety instructions and do not attempt to resolve electrical or structural issues yourself.
